extractions.extraction_text: The insurance cover provided to You under this Policy is based on the information You have provided to Us.

attributes.plain_english: This policy is only valid if you honestly and completely tell us all the facts about your vehicle and driving history.  If you don't, you may not be able to make a claim.

extractions.extraction_text: driving is not disqualified by order of a Court of Law or by reason of any enactment or regulation in that behalf

attributes.plain_english: If you're driving and have a court order, or are breaking a law, that prevents you from driving, this policy won't cover any accidents that happen.

extractions.extraction_text: permission to drive has not been withdrawn by the Policyholder

attributes.plain_english: If you're driving and the Policyholder has told you not to drive their vehicle, this policy won't cover accidents.

extractions.extraction_text: any member of the Policyholder's family or a paid driver who have been driving any vehicle described in the Schedule during the life of the Policyholder and permission to drive has not been withdrawn prior to the death of the Policyholder.

attributes.plain_english: If someone driving the vehicle is a family member or paid driver, and the Policyholder has not withdrawn permission to drive, this policy won't cover accidents.

extractions.extraction_text: any other person who has been given permission to drive any vehicle described in the Schedule prior to the death of the Policyholder and such permission has not been withdrawn by the Policyholder.

attributes.plain_english: If someone has been given permission to drive the vehicle before the Policyholder withdrew it, this policy won't cover accidents.

extractions.extraction_text: Geographical Area - That part of Thailand within 80 kilometres of the border between Thailand and West Malaysia

attributes.plain_english: This policy does not cover damage occurring within 80 kilometers of the border between Thailand and West Malaysia.

extractions.extraction_text: Geographical Area - Transit by direct sea route across: the straits between the island of Penang and the mainland of West Malaysia

attributes.plain_english: Damage occurring during transit via the specific sea routes between Penang and West Malaysia is not covered.

extractions.extraction_text: Geographical Area - the straits between Changi Point, Singapore and Tanjong Belungkor, Johore

attributes.plain_english: Damage occurring during transit via the specific sea routes between Changi Point and Tanjong Belungkor is not covered.

extractions.extraction_text: Legislation - The reference of Legislation under the heading "Avoidance of Certain Terms and Right of Recovery" is limited to Sections 94, 95, 96 of the Road Transport Act 1987 (Malaysia) and Sections 7, 8 and 9 of the Motor Vehicles (Third Party Risks & Compensation) Act (Republic of Singapore).

attributes.plain_english: The policy's legal framework is limited to the specified sections of the Road Transport Act and Motor Vehicles Act. Other legal interpretations may not apply.

extractions.extraction_text: extension of the damage or any further damage to the Insured Vehicle shall be excluded from the scope of the indemnity granted by this Policy.

attributes.plain_english: If you drive the vehicle before repairs are made, any additional damage caused will not be covered by this insurance.  Essentially, if you continue to use the vehicle after an accident until it's fixed, any resulting damage isn't covered.

extractions.extraction_text: Any refund will be payable if the refund premium is less than S$25 or where a claim (including claim for windscreen or windows or IU) has arisen under the Policy.

attributes.plain_english: You won't receive a refund of your premium if it's less than $25, or if you've made a claim (like for a cracked windshield).

extractions.extraction_text: for the risk insured, the Policyholder has never had any insurance terminated in the last twelve (12) months due solely or in part to a breach of any premium payment condition

attributes.plain_english: If your previous insurance policy was cancelled because you didn't pay your premiums on time, this policy won't cover you.

extractions.extraction_text: if the Policyholder has declared that it has breached any premium payment condition in respect of a previous policy taken up with another insurer in the last twelve (12) months: (i) the Policyholder has fully paid all outstanding premium for time on risk calculated by the previous insurer based on the customary short period rate in respect of the previous policy; and (ii) a copy of the written confirmation from the previous insurer to this effect is first provided by the Policyholder to Us before cover incepts.

attributes.plain_english: If you've told us you broke a previous insurance policy due to late payments, you'll need to repay the full amount owed to your old insurer, and provide proof of this repayment before this new policy starts.

extractions.extraction_text: total premium not paid and actually received in full on or before the inception date

attributes.plain_english: If you don't pay the full premium by the date the policy starts, the policy will not be in effect, and no benefits will be payable.  Essentially, the policy never attached.

extractions.extraction_text: failure to report accidents

failure to comply with this condition precedent will result in You or Your Authorised Driver being denied indemnity under both Section I and Section II of the Policy in respect of that particular accident and/or occurrence.

{'plain_english': "If you don't report an accident to the insurance company within 24 hours, you won't be able to make a claim under this policy for that specific accident.", 'severity': 'High', 'consequence': 'Loss of claim entitlement'}
NCD - Non-Reporting
Non-Reporting NCD - Refers to the loss of percentage of No Claim Discount as a result of not reporting or late reporting of an accident

{'plain_english': "If you don't report an accident promptly, or if you report it late, you could lose your No Claim Discount (NCD). This is because the insurance company needs to know about all incidents to assess risk and maintain accurate pricing."}
Claim Procedure - No Admission
No admission, offer, promise or payment shall be made by or on behalf of You or any person claiming to be indemnified without Us giving Our written consent.

{'plain_english': "You can't make any statements about the accident (like admitting fault or offering a payment) without the insurance company's written permission. They need to control the process."}
Claim Procedure - Right to Control

We may at Our sole discretion: (a) take over and conduct in Your name or such person the defence or settlement of any claim, or (b) prosecute in Your name or such person for Our own benefit any claim for indemnity or damages
{'plain_english': 'The insurance company has the right to handle the entire claim process on your behalf, including defending it in court if necessary.'}
Claim Procedure - Right to Examine Damage
We have this right whether or not You or Your Authorised Driver is entitled or intends to claim an indemnity under this Policy for the damage to the Insured Vehicle.
{'plain_english': 'The insurance company has the right to inspect the damage to your vehicle before agreeing to pay out a claim. This is regardless of whether you decide to make a claim or not.'}
Claim Procedure - Time Limit to Claim
You shall decide whether or not to claim for such damage under this Policy and if so claiming, shall submit such a claim to Us within fourteen (14) days of occurrence or discovery of damage.
{'plain_english': 'You must decide whether to make a claim and, if you do, you have only 14 days from when the damage happened or when you discovered it to submit a claim.'}
Claim Procedure - Repair Cost Limit
The quoted cost of repair is subject to adjustment by Us before any repair may commence if it exceeds the Authorised Repair Limit in total.
{'plain_english': "The insurance company can adjust the repair cost if it's higher than the pre-agreed 'Authorised Repair Limit'. They won't pay for repairs that exceed this amount."}
Other Insurance - Rateable Proportion
We shall not be liable to pay or contribute more than Our rateable proportion of any loss, damage, compensation, costs or expenses.
{'plain_english': "If you have other insurance covering the same loss, the insurance company will only pay its fair share of the costs, based on the policy's rateable proportion."}
damage caused by war, invasion, act of foreign enemies, civil war, rebellion, revolution, terrorism, or malicious acts of sabotage

attributes.plain_english: This policy doesn't cover damage resulting from war, acts of terrorism, or any kind of deliberate sabotage.

extractions.extraction_text: damage caused by wear and tear, gradual deterioration, rust, corrosion, or decay

attributes.plain_english: The policy won't pay out for damage that's simply due to the normal aging process or deterioration of the vehicle.

extractions.extraction_text: damage caused by faulty materials or workmanship

attributes.plain_english: If the damage is caused by something that was poorly made or used incorrectly, this policy won't cover it.

extractions.extraction_text: damage caused by abnormally excessive wear and tear

attributes.plain_english: If the damage is due to using the vehicle in a way that's far beyond its normal use, it's not covered.

extractions.extraction_text: damage caused by the use of the vehicle for hire or reward, racing, stunts, or other non-normal use

attributes.plain_english: This policy doesn't cover damage if you're using the vehicle for commercial purposes (like driving for a taxi) or if you're engaging in risky driving activities.

extractions.extraction_text: outside the Geographical Area

attributes.plain_english: This policy doesn't cover damage if you're driving or if your vehicle is damaged outside the area specified in your policy. You'll need separate insurance for those situations.

extractions.extraction_text: being used otherwise than in accordance with the Limitations as to Use

attributes.plain_english: If you use your vehicle in a way that isn't allowed by the policy's terms (like using it for commercial purposes when it's only covered for personal use), this isn't covered.

extractions.extraction_text: being driven by or is for the purpose of being driven by him in the charge of any person other than an Authorised Driver

attributes.plain_english: If someone other than a driver you've specifically authorized (an 'Authorized Driver') is driving your vehicle, this isn't covered.

extractions.extraction_text: being driven by the Policyholder or by any person on the order of or with the permission of the Policyholder whilst under the influence of intoxicating liquor or drugs

attributes.plain_english: Driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs – this is not covered.

extractions.extraction_text: being used or driven when it is not registered or licensed under the legislation or when the registration or licensing under the legislation has been cancelled

attributes.plain_english: If your vehicle isn't properly registered or licensed, this isn't covered.

extractions.extraction_text: being used or driven with modifications that have not been approved by the Registrar of Vehicles in accordance with the Road Traffic (Motor Vehicles, Registration and Licensing) Rules or by any relevant regulatory authority

attributes.plain_english: Any modifications to the vehicle that haven't been officially approved aren't covered.

extractions.extraction_text: Any liability which attaches by virtue of an agreement but which would not have attached in the absence of such agreement

attributes.plain_english: Liability arising from a contract that wouldn't have existed without the contract itself.

extractions.extraction_text: Any loss, damage, liability or expense directly or indirectly caused by or contributed to by or arising from: ionising radiations from or contamination by radioactivity from any nuclear fuel or from any nuclear waste or from the combustion of nuclear fuel

attributes.plain_english: Damage caused by nuclear materials or their use is not covered.

extractions.extraction_text: the radioactive, toxic, explosive or other hazardous or contaminating properties of any nuclear installation, reactor or other nuclear assembly or nuclear components thereof

attributes.plain_english: Damage caused by nuclear installations or components is not covered.

extractions.extraction_text: any weapon or device employing atomic or nuclear fission and/or fusion or other like reaction or radioactive force or matter

attributes.plain_english: Damage caused by weapons or devices using atomic or nuclear reactions is not covered.

extractions.extraction_text: the radioactive, toxic, explosive or other hazardous or contaminating properties of any radioactive matter

attributes.plain_english: Damage caused by radioactive materials is not covered.

extractions.extraction_text: any chemical, biological, bio-chemical or electromagnetic weapon

attributes.plain_english: This policy doesn't cover damage caused by weapons like chemical, biological, or electromagnetic weapons.

extractions.extraction_text: permanent or temporary dispossession resulting from confiscation nationalisation commandeering or requisition by any lawfully constituted authority

attributes.plain_english: If your vehicle is taken by the government (through confiscation, nationalization, commandeering, or requisition), this policy won't cover the resulting damage.

extractions.extraction_text: permanent or temporary dispossession of Insured Vehicle resulting from the unlawful occupation of such Insured Vehicle by any person

attributes.plain_english: If someone unlawfully occupies your vehicle, causing damage, this policy won't cover it.

extractions.extraction_text: the destruction of Insured Vehicle by order of any public authority

attributes.plain_english: If your vehicle is destroyed due to an order from a public authority, this policy won't cover the damage.

extractions.extraction_text: war, invasion, acts of foreign enemies, hostilities or warlike operations

attributes.plain_english: This policy doesn't cover damage caused by war, including things like invasions, enemy attacks, or military actions – whether a war is officially declared or not.

extractions.extraction_text: civil war, rebellion, revolution, insurrection, civil commotion assuming the proportions of or amounting to an uprising, military or usurped power

attributes.plain_english: Damage caused by civil unrest, such as rebellions, revolutions, or riots, is not covered.

extractions.extraction_text: terrorism

attributes.plain_english: Damage caused by acts of terrorism – including the use of force, violence, or threats of harm to people or property – is not covered. This includes damage from nuclear radiation or contamination by chemical or biological agents.

extractions.extraction_text: strike or riot

attributes.plain_english: Damage resulting from strikes or riots is not covered.  You'll need to prove the damage wasn't caused by the strike or riot itself.

extractions.extraction_text: Payment by Us under this sub-section will not affect Your No Claim Discount.

attributes.plain_english: This policy doesn't protect your 'No Claim Discount'. If you make a claim under this windscreen damage section, you'll lose your discount.

extractions.extraction_text: Excess amount as shown in the Schedule and its applicable GST

attributes.plain_english: You will always have to pay the ‘Excess’ amount listed in your policy schedule, plus any applicable sales tax (GST), when a claim is made.

extractions.extraction_text: Young and/or Inexperienced Driver Excess of S$3,000 and its applicable GST

attributes.plain_english: If someone under 26 years old or with less than 2 years of driving experience drives the vehicle and there’s damage, you’ll have to pay an extra S$3,000 plus tax on top of the standard ‘Excess’ amount.

extractions.extraction_text: depreciation, wear and tear, mechanical or electronic breakdown, equipment or computer malfunction

attributes.plain_english: This policy doesn't cover normal wear and tear, breakdowns, or problems with the vehicle's electronics or computer systems.  It's like not covering a worn-out shoe – it's expected that things will eventually need replacing.

extractions.extraction_text: the failure or inability of any equipment or any computer program to recognise or correctly to interpret or process any date as the true or correct date or to continue to function correctly beyond that date

attributes.plain_english: The policy doesn't cover problems if a computer system (like a navigation system) misreads a date or stops working correctly after a certain point.  It's about the system's functionality, not the cause of the problem.

extractions.extraction_text: damage to tyres unless damage is caused to other parts of the Insured Vehicle simultaneously in the same accident

attributes.plain_english: If your tires are damaged, this policy won't cover it unless the damage happened at the same time as damage to other parts of the car in the same accident.  For example, if a tire blows out due to a separate issue, this wouldn't be covered.

extractions.extraction_text: death of or bodily injury to any person arising out of and in the course of such person's employment by the person claiming to be the indemnified under this Section

attributes.plain_english: This policy *won't* cover death or injury if it happens because someone is working for the person claiming the insurance money.  Essentially, if an employee is hurt while doing their job, the insurance won't pay out.

extractions.extraction_text: damage to property belonging to or held in trust by or in the custody or control of: (i) the Policyholder or any member of his household, (ii) any Authorised Driver claiming to be indemnified under Section II - 2 or any member of his household.

attributes.plain_english: The policy *doesn't* cover damage to your own property (like your house or car) or the property of people you authorize to drive (Authorized Drivers) or their families.  It also doesn't cover damage to property held in trust or under someone's control.

extractions.extraction_text: occurring more than three (3) calendar months after the accident

attributes.plain_english: If you're injured and claim payment, it must happen within three months of the accident date. If it's later than three months, we won't pay out.

extractions.extraction_text: intentional self-injury, suicide, attempted suicide

attributes.plain_english: This policy does not cover damage or injury resulting from intentionally harming yourself, attempting suicide, or suicide attempts, regardless of whether they are illegal.

extractions.extraction_text: physical or mental defect or infirmity

attributes.plain_english: The policy doesn't cover injuries or damages caused by pre-existing physical or mental health conditions.

extractions.extraction_text: accident happening while the driver of the Insured Vehicle is under the influence of intoxicating liquor or drugs

attributes.plain_english: The policy does not cover accidents that occur if the driver is under the influence of alcohol or drugs.

extractions.extraction_text: pro rata proportion of the compensation

attributes.plain_english: If more people are in the vehicle than it's legally designed to hold, the compensation will be calculated based on a proportional amount, not the full amount.

extractions.extraction_text: judgments which are not in the first instance delivered by or obtained from a Court of competent jurisdiction within West Malaysia or the Republic of Singapore

attributes.plain_english: This policy doesn't cover claims where the initial court decision is made outside of West Malaysia or the Republic of Singapore.

extractions.extraction_text: Limit of the amount of Our liability under Section II - Items 1(a) and 2(a) in respect of any one claim or series of claims arising out of one event

attributes.plain_english: This policy has a limit on how much the insurer will pay out for a single incident or a series of related incidents. The maximum amount covered is not unlimited.

extractions.extraction_text: Limit of the amount of Our liability under Section II - Items 1(b) and 2(b) in respect of any one claim or series of claims arising out of one event

attributes.plain_english: This policy has a limit on how much the insurer will pay out for a single incident or a series of related incidents. The maximum amount covered is S$5,000,000.

extractions.extraction_text: Limit of the amount of Our liability under Section II - Item 5(c) in respect of legal services for defence in the event of any charge

attributes.plain_english: The insurer will not cover legal fees if you are being charged with an offense related to the incident.

extractions.extraction_text: Limit of the amount of Our liability under Section III in respect of each person injured arising out of one accident

attributes.plain_english: The insurer will not cover medical expenses for each individual injured in a single accident. There is a limit on the amount paid per person.

extractions.extraction_text: Authorised Repair Limit S$350

attributes.plain_english: The insurer will not cover the cost of repairs exceeding S$350.

extractions.extraction_text: Car pooling Arrangements

attributes.plain_english: This policy does not cover situations where you are using a vehicle for carpooling (transporting passengers for hire or reward).

extractions.extraction_text: Arrangement and Payment of Emergency Medical Evacuation and Repatriation

attributes.plain_english: This policy does not cover the arrangement and payment for emergency medical evacuation or repatriation services. You will need to arrange and pay for these separately.

extractions.extraction_text: damage and/or theft of car radio/cassette/compact disc player

attributes.plain_english: This policy does not cover damage or theft of your car's radio, cassette player, or compact disc player.

extractions.extraction_text: damage and/or theft of car radio/cassette/compact disc player

attributes.plain_english: The policy does not cover loss or damage to car audio equipment.

extractions.extraction_text: loss or damage not made good by repair reinstatement or replacement

attributes.plain_english: This policy doesn't cover damage where the vehicle can be fully repaired, replaced, or reinstated.  Essentially, if the damage is so extensive that a full repair isn't possible, this damage isn't covered.

extractions.extraction_text: death of or bodily injury to any person in the employment of the Passenger

attributes.plain_english: This policy *doesn't* cover injuries to someone who is your employee while they're working with you.

extractions.extraction_text: damage to property belonging to or held in trust by or in the custody or control of the Passenger

attributes.plain_english: The policy *doesn't* cover damage to property you own, or that you're holding for someone else (like a trustee), or that you're transporting.

extractions.extraction_text: the amount payable for storage charges of the Insured Vehicle shall be limited to the number of days recommended by the Surveyor to repair or replace any part of the Insured Vehicle subject to a maximum of S$500

attributes.plain_english: The policy will not cover storage costs exceeding S$500, regardless of the surveyor's recommendation.

extractions.extraction_text: A: such person is not entitled to indemnity under any other Policy

attributes.plain_english: If the person using the vehicle has other insurance coverage that covers the same loss, this policy won't pay out. It's like having duplicate insurance – only one will pay.

extractions.extraction_text: strike or riot

attributes.plain_english: This policy *doesn't* cover damage caused by a strike or riot. However, it *does* cover damage if a police force is acting to suppress the disturbance or minimize its effects.

extractions.extraction_text: civil commotion

attributes.plain_english: This policy *doesn't* cover damage caused by a civil commotion.  It *does* cover damage if a police force is acting to suppress the disturbance or minimize its effects.

extractions.extraction_text: war, invasion, acts of foreign enemies, hostilities or warlike operations (whether war be declared or not)

attributes.plain_english: This policy doesn't cover damage caused by war, including declared and undeclared wars, invasions, or any military actions.

extractions.extraction_text: civil war, rebellion, revolution, insurrection, civil commotion assuming the proportions of or amounting to an uprising, military or usurped power

attributes.plain_english: Damage resulting from civil unrest, rebellions, revolutions, or any form of uprising is not covered.

extractions.extraction_text: any act of terrorism including but not limited to (i) the use or threat of force, violence and/or (ii) harm or damage to life or to property (or threat of such harm or damage) including, but not limited to, nuclear radiation and/or contamination by chemical and/or biological agents

attributes.plain_english: This policy does not cover damage caused by terrorism, including acts of violence, threats of violence, or damage resulting from nuclear radiation, chemical, or biological contamination.

extractions.extraction_text: any action taken in controlling, preventing, suppressing or in any way relating to (a) or (b) above

attributes.plain_english: The policy doesn't cover damage or liability resulting from actions taken to control, prevent, or suppress the events outlined in sections (a) and (b).

text:
--- PAGE 1 ---

Here is Your insurance Policy. Please examine it together with the Schedule,
to make sure that You have the protection You need.

It is important that the Policy, the Schedule and any amendments are read
together to avoid misunderstanding.

If there are any changes that may affect the insurance provided, please
notify Us immediately.

IMPORTANT NOTICE
The insurance cover provided to You under this Policy is based on
the information You have provided to Us.

Please be reminded that You must fully and faithfully declare to Us
the facts that You know or ought to know, otherwise You may receive
no benefit from the Policy.

HOW YOUR INSURANCE OPERATES

Your Private Motor Car Policy is a contract between Us, the Company, and
You, Our Policyholder named in the Schedule. The application form,
declaration and any information given form the basis of this contract.

The insurance We provide in this Policy is subject to the terms, conditions,
exclusions contained in this Policy, Certificate of Insurance, the Schedule
and any Endorsement to this Policy (hereinafter collectively referred to as
the "Terms of this Policy").

In consideration of Your paying to Us the required Premium, We agree to
indemnify You in the manner and to the extent described in the Policy and
in the Schedule, in respect of events occurring during the Period of
Insurance, or any subsequent period for which You pay and We accept
the required Premium.

OUR PROMISE OF SERVICE

We wish to provide You with a high standard of service and to meet any
claims covered by this Policy honestly, fairly and promptly. Should You
have any reason to believe that We have not done so, please contact Your
broker or agent. If You do not use the services of a professional intermediary,
please contact Us directly.

A GUIDE TO YOUR PRIVATE MOTOR CAR POLICY

DEFINITION OF WORDS
(Applicable to the whole Policy)

Certain words have been defined below. These words have the same
meaning wherever they are used in the Policy or the Schedule and are
highlighted in the Policy by being shown in bold print, e.g. Policyholder,
Insured Vehicle, etc.

Policyholder / Insured / You / Your
means or refers to the person who contracted the insurance with MSIG
Insurance (Singapore) Pte. Ltd. and under whose name this Policy has
been issued.

Authorised Driver
means or refers to:

1.
any person named in the Schedule as "Authorised Drivers" and/or any
person named in Certificate of Insurance under "Persons or classes
of persons entitled to drive"
2.
In the event of the death of the Policyholder, Authorised Driver
includes:
a.
any member of the Policyholder's family or a paid driver who have
been driving any vehicle described in the Schedule during the life
of the Policyholder and permission to drive has not been withdrawn
prior to the death of the Policyholder.
b.
any other person who has been given permission to drive any
vehicle described in the Schedule prior to the death of the
Policyholder and such permission has not been withdrawn by the
Policyholder.

Provided that the person driving is permitted in accordance with the licensing
or other laws or regulations to drive any vehicle described in the Schedule
or has been so permitted and is not disqualified by order of a Court of Law
or by reason of any enactment or regulation in that behalf from driving such
vehicle.

We / Us / Our / the Company
means MSIG Insurance (Singapore) Pte. Ltd.

The Schedule
means a document which is part of the Policy which gives details of the
cover You have.

Insured Vehicle
means the vehicle we are insuring for You as shown in the Schedule, fitted
with standard equipment by the manufacturer or distributor without any
modification to any parts, accessories, windscreen and/or windows, unless
otherwise declared with details and endorsed under this Policy.

Geographical Area
1.
The Republic of Singapore
2.
West Malaysia
3.
Transit by direct sea route across:
a.
the straits between the island of Penang and the mainland of West
Malaysia
b.
the straits between Changi Point, Singapore and Tanjong Belungkor,
Johore
subject to the Policyholder or other person for the time being in charge
of the Insured Vehicle having complied in all things with the rules,
regulations or lawful directions of the carrier
4.
That part of Thailand within 80 kilometres of the border between Thailand
and West Malaysia

Legislation
Road Transport Act 1987 (Malaysia), Motor Vehicles (Third Party Risks &
Compensation) Act (Cap. 189) (Republic of Singapore), Road Traffic Act
(Cap 276) (Republic of Singapore) or any Amendment, Act or Acts passed
in substitution.

The reference of Legislation under the heading "Avoidance of Certain Terms
and Right of Recovery" is limited to Sections 94, 95, 96 of the Road Transport
Act 1987 (Malaysia) and Sections 7, 8 and 9 of the Motor Vehicles (Third
Party Risks & Compensation) Act (Republic of Singapore).

GENERAL CONDITIONS
(Applicable to the whole Policy)

It is an important part of our contract that You observe the following General
Conditions:

convey or cause to be conveyed the Insured Vehicle to Our Authorised

notice of the occurrence to Us and the police and cooperate with us
in securing the conviction of the offender.

Every letter, claim, writ, summons and process shall be notified or
forwarded unanswered to Us immediately on receipt. Notice shall also
be given to Us immediately after You or any person claiming to be
indemnified shall have knowledge of any impending prosecution, inquest,
inquiry or offer of composition in connection with any such accident

Driver being denied indemnity under both Section I and Section II of
the Policy in respect of that particular accident and/or occurrence.
Notwithstanding the No Claim Discount provisions set out herein, failure
to comply with this condition precedent will additionally result in You
